Read on👇 ▪️May 10, 2026: PM Modi appealed to Indians to buy less gold 👉Result: Indians didn’t give a damn 👉Gold demand in India actually increased after Modi’s appeal • Q1 FY27 Total gold demand: 131 tonne
items.title_zh: 国大党发言人：莫迪劝民众少买黄金，结果走私暴增1500%
items.summary_en:
Mr Modi has been saying - Indians bought less gold because he asked them to. 

That’s a BIG lie. Read on👇

▪️May 10, 2026: PM Modi appealed to Indians to buy less gold 

👉Result: Indians didn’t give a damn

👉Gold demand in India actually increased after Modi’s appeal

• Q1 FY27 Total gold demand: 131 tonnes
• Q2 FY 27 Total gold demand: 162.5 tonnes

▪️May 13, 2026: Modi govt raised Import duty by 2.5 times to 15% from the earlier 6% - the sharpest single hike in history 

👉 Result was a drop in official gold imports, but smuggling of gold skyrocketed 

• Q2 FY27 official gold imports: ⬇️ 70% at 64 tonnes

• Q2 FY27 unofficial gold imports: ⬆️ 1500% at 50 tonnes

▪️The bottom line is that Modi’s appeal didn’t stop people from buying gold. His decision encouraged smuggling of gold!
items.summary_zh: 国大党发言人苏普丽娅·施里纳特发帖反驳莫迪“印度人听我的少买了黄金”的说法：她称莫迪5月10日呼吁少买黄金后，需求反而从一季度131吨升到二季度162.5吨；5月13日政府把黄金进口关税从6%提到15%后，官方进口下降70%至64吨，非官方（走私）进口却暴涨1500%至50吨。评论区有网友@grok核查，grok回复称数据基本与世界黄金协会一致；也有人嘲讽她撒谎。

items.title_zh: 阿米特·沙阿宣布：阿卡利党重回NDA，与BJP再结盟
items.summary_en:
भाजपा और शिरोमणि अकाली दल का गठबंधन राजनीतिक गठबंधन से आगे बढ़कर साझी विरासत और साझे संकल्प का एक नेचुरल अलायंस है, जिसने हमेशा पंजाब में शांति व प्रगति को प्राथमिकता दी है। दोनों दलों का फिर एक मंच पर आना स्वाभाविक भी है और पंजाब के लिए आवश्यक भी।

श्री गुरु नानक देव जी के प्रकाश पर्व के पावन दिन शिरोमणि अकाली दल की NDA में वापसी पर सरदार सुखबीर सिंह बादल जी और उनके सभी साथियों का मैं हृदय से स्वागत करता हूँ।

नशामुक्त पंजाब के साथ-साथ गैंगस्टरों पर कठोर कार्रवाई के लिए सख्त कानून व्यवस्था, प्रदेश का आर्थिक विकास और किसानों की समस्याओं का समाधान, ये NDA की प्राथमिकताएँ हैं।

भाजपा और शिरोमणि अकाली दल के कार्यकर्ता विकसित, सुरक्षित व समृद्ध पंजाब बनाने के हमारे संदेश को जन-जन तक पहुँचाएँगे। हम मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में नशामुक्त पंजाब बनाने के लिए संकल्पित हैं।
items.summary_zh: 印度内政部长阿米特·沙阿发帖称，在锡克教祖师古鲁·那纳克诞辰这天，欢迎苏赫比尔·辛格·巴达尔率希罗马尼阿卡利党重返全国民主联盟（NDA），称两党是“天然联盟”，将以禁毒、严打黑帮、发展经济和解决农民问题为优先事项，建设“无毒品旁遮普”。评论区有人力挺，也有人嘲讽这对组合并预言BJP在旁遮普拿不到几个席位。

items.title_en: Army regiment steps in as family at late soldier's daughter's wedding in Rajasthan
items.title_zh: 拉贾斯坦邦已故士兵的女儿举行婚礼，军团出面充当家人
items.summary_en: Officers and soldiers of the 16th Jat Regiment attended Preeti's Alwar wedding and performed her late father's traditional duties. Their support underscored the regiment's continuing bond with Havildar Pappal Singh's family.
items.summary_zh: 第16贾特团的军官和士兵出席了普里蒂在阿尔瓦尔的婚礼，并代她已故的父亲履行传统职责。他们的支持表明，该团与上士帕帕尔·辛格一家的联系仍在继续。

items.title_en: From AI makeovers to Lucia-inspired makeup, GTA 6 trend takes over social media

The incident reportedly took place in Til Begampur village under the Sikandrabad area
items.title_zh: 最“克制”的小偷：女佣从一沓现金里只抽走一张500卢比
items.summary_en:
A bizarre theft from Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, has gone viral after CCTV footage allegedly captured a domestic worker stealing just one ₹500 note from a bundle of cash while leaving the remaining money untouched. 

The incident reportedly took place in Til Begampur village under the Sikandrabad area. The homeowner, Kallu Mewati, was asleep when the worker allegedly took a bundle of cash from a kurta pocket, removed a single ₹500 note and carefully placed the remaining notes back exactly as they were.
items.summary_zh: NDTV报道，北方邦布兰德谢赫尔（Bulandshahr）蒂尔贝甘布尔村一段监控视频走红：房主卡卢·梅瓦蒂睡觉时，一名家政工从他的库尔塔口袋里掏出一沓钱，只抽出一张500卢比，再把剩下的钱原样放回。评论区有人说“这是每天的偷法”，也有人说他聪明，不想杀掉下金蛋的鸡。

Located in Madhya Pradesh's Anuppu
items.title_zh: 许愿钻石象肚子，信徒卡在一半动弹不得
items.summary_en:
Viral video shows devotee trapped while crawling under stone elephant statue at Madhya Pradesh temple

The footage, reportedly from the Narmada Temple in Amarkantak, shows several people gathering around the structure to help the devotee after he was trapped midway.

Located in Madhya Pradesh's Anuppur district, the temple features a religious ritual in which devotees crawl through the narrow gap between the elephant's legs, a practice locally believed to fulfill wishes. In the viral clip, the man attempts the ritual but gets wedged halfway through.

items.title_en: Elon Musk's Companies Face Lawsuits In US States Over Non-Consensual Sexual Images Given By Grok AI

items.summary_en: US states - Virginia and Oregon - have sued Elon Musk's companies, alleging Grok generated non-consensual sexual images, including child-related content, while failing to enforce adequate safety safeguards., US News, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 美国的弗吉尼亚州和俄勒冈州起诉埃隆·马斯克的公司，称Grok生成了未经同意的性图像，包括与儿童有关的内容，且未能执行足够的安全防护。

items.title_en: 'Cyberpunk 2 Is Cancelled': CD Projekt Red Developer After GTA 6 Success
items.title_zh: “《赛博朋克2》取消了”：《GTA 6》大获成功后，CD Projekt Red开发者如此说道
items.summary_en: Cyberpunk 2 creative director, Igor Sarzynski, joked that the successor to Cyberpunk 2077 stood cancelled after GTA 6's success.
items.summary_zh: 《赛博朋克2》创意总监伊戈尔·萨任斯基开玩笑说，《赛博朋克2077》的续作在《GTA 6》成功之后算是取消了。

items.title_en: Google rejects rumours of 'huge layoffs' in India, says 30 roles were eliminated
items.title_zh: 谷歌否认在印度“大规模裁员”的传闻，称有30个岗位被取消
items.summary_en: Google has rejected rumours of “huge layoffs” within its Cloud division in India, calling them “totally inaccurate”.
items.summary_zh: 谷歌否认其印度云部门存在“大规模裁员”的传闻，称这些说法“完全不准确”。

items.title_en: 5.4-Magnitude Earthquake Rocks Nepal, Tremors Felt Across Parts of India, Bhutan, China
items.title_zh: 5.4级地震震动尼泊尔，印度、不丹、中国部分地区有震感
items.summary_en: There were no immediate reports of casualties or significant damage to property following the earthquake. Authorities are expected to assess the situation and monitor any developments in the affected areas.
items.summary_zh: 地震后没有立即传出人员伤亡或财产重大损失的报告。当局预计将评估情况，并监测受影响地区的后续动态。

items.title_en: 'They Wanted You Back': Jensen Huang Gets Rousing Welcome at Nvidia HQ; Elon Musk Reacts
items.title_zh: “他们想让你回来”：黄仁勋在英伟达总部受到热烈欢迎；埃隆·马斯克作出回应
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang received a roaring welcome from employees upon returning to the company's headquarters. Reacting to the moment, Elon Musk noted that the staff clearly wanted him back.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋回到公司总部时，受到员工热烈欢迎。埃隆·马斯克对此表示，员工显然想让他回来。

items.title_en: 'Own Goal': Allahabad HC Pulls Up Lawyer For Citing Google Article During Hearing
items.title_zh: “乌龙”：安拉阿巴德高等法院训斥律师在庭审中引用谷歌文章
items.summary_en: The Allahabad High Court reprimanded a lawyer for relying on a Google article and misquoting a Supreme Court judgment while arguing a criminal revision petition., India News, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 安拉阿巴德高等法院斥责一名律师在审理刑事再审申请时依赖一篇谷歌文章，并错误引用最高法院的判决。

items.title_en: Elon Musk on standing by Jensen Huang: 'Fair-weather friends are worthless'
items.title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克谈支持黄仁勋：“只能共安乐的朋友毫无价值”
items.summary_en: Elon Musk praised Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO, saying supporters who stand by someone during difficult times are their real friends.
items.summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克称赞黄仁勋回归英伟达首席执行官一职，并说在困难时期仍站在一个人身边的支持者，才是真正的朋友。

items.title_en: Mathura, Hindutva And Development: BJP Lays Ground For 2027 UP Poll Battle
items.title_zh: 马图拉、印度教特性与发展：印度人民党为2027年北方邦选举布局
items.summary_en: The BJP has sharpened its 2027 Uttar Pradesh poll strategy, focusing on Hindutva, development and the Mathura temple issue, while dismissing the proposed SP-Congress alliance as insignificant., India News, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 印度人民党已收紧2027年北方邦选举策略，重点放在印度教特性、发展和马图拉寺庙问题上，同时认为拟议中的社会党与国大党联盟无足轻重。

items.title_en: Can Eating Oranges, Amla And Vitamin C-Rich Foods Protect You From Air Pollution Damage?
items.title_zh: 吃橙子、余甘子和富含维生素C的食物，能避免空气污染造成的伤害吗？
items.summary_en: While oranges, amla and other antioxidant-rich foods can support the body's defences, experts explain why they cannot undo pollution damage or protect the lungs from toxic air., Health, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 橙子、余甘子和其他富含抗氧化物的食物可以支持人体的防御，但专家解释，它们无法消除污染造成的伤害，也不能保护肺部免受有毒空气影响。

items.title_en: Nvidia Value Jumps Nearly $1 Trillion, Wall Street Roars as Jensen Huang Returns
items.title_zh: 黄仁勋回归后，英伟达市值跃升近1万亿美元，华尔街一片欢呼
items.summary_en: Jensen Huang's return came after a brief resignation related to personal controversies. Other tech companies also saw gains amid the recovery, Markets, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋此次回归，是在因个人争议短暂辞职之后。复苏之际，其他科技公司也出现上涨。

items.title_en: The Cinnamon Spice Hair Trend is Heating Up: A Guide to Choosing Your Shade and Makeup
items.title_zh: 肉桂色发色热潮升温：如何选择色调和妆容
items.summary_en: There's absolutely no one that can't or shouldn't jump on the warmest beauty trend for this winter season. But a few tweaks to the vanity is essential to make it work in your favour. , Fashion, Times Now
items.summary_zh: 这个冬季最暖的美容潮流，没有人不能跟上，也没有人不该跟上。但要让它适合自己，梳妆台上需要做几处调整。

items.title_en: Dreams Of Families Are Shattered When Youth Come Under Influence Of Drugs: PM Modi
items.title_zh: 莫迪总理：年轻人一旦受毒品影响，家庭的梦想就会破碎

items.summary_zh: 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪在德里一场与古鲁那纳克·德夫诞辰同时举行的沙巴德吉尔坦活动上强调，引导年轻人远离毒瘾十分重要。

items.title_en: Full List of Nvidia Board of Directors: Meet the 10 Members Who Reinstated Jensen Huang

items.summary_zh: 董事会对黄仁勋的领导表示有信心，并强调他对利益相关者的重要性。

items.title_en: Students Bunk School To Watch India-New Zealand Test Match, Hide As Camera Spots Them
items.title_zh: 学生逃课去看印度对新西兰的测试赛，被摄像机拍到后躲了起来

items.title_en: ‘AI will run the world': US CEO tells employees to complete 5-hour AI course or risk poor performance reviews
items.title_zh: “人工智能将主宰世界”：美国首席执行官要求员工完成5小时人工智能课程，否则绩效考核可能不佳
items.summary_en: The course was launched by Job van der Voort to help workers understand how to use AI in their day-to-day jobs.
